notes: No release before 0.5.0 may claim any of this is balanced: every magnitude raid-engagement added carries tuningStatus untuned and the balance harness owns all of them. These gate sweeps submit no god verb and open no portal, so they cannot observe a raid at all -- which is exactly why every number here is unchanged, and is not evidence that the raid layer works. The measurement that says the raid verbs are not decoration is packages/rules-raid/test/unit/verbs.test.ts, paired over eight seeds. The reference universe also remains degenerate in the known ways W7 and W17 recorded, and this change closes none of them: it adds verbs to a layer no gate sweep reaches. What it does close is the question ui/raid asked -- a player now has something to do while a raid runs -- and that is a claim about agency rather than about balance.
rationale: W37 made the raid something a player plays (docs/design/raid-engagement.md): the three-phase engagement, the mid-raid ruleset lock and its post-raid revert surcharge, and the six raid verbs with Vis and exposure. Fourteen untuned content magnitudes were added -- eleven raid constants and one god constant, plus the two phase boundaries -- which moves contentHash d37624e3 to 74e73627 and invalidates this baseline by provenance regardless of any metric. NOTHING MOVED. Every metric in this gate is identical to the superseded value to five decimal places, 0.00 standard errors, because none of the additions is on a world-scale path: the phase is derived and read by nothing in the tick loop, the lock and the verbs live inside an engagement, and no scenario in this sweep opens a portal. No RNG stream was added and rngRegistryHash is unchanged; the one verb that creates a combatant draws on stream 11 with a fresh spawn ordinal, which insertion invariance makes a re-roll of nothing. This regeneration is therefore provenance-only, and the zero deltas below are the evidence for that claim rather than a formality.
